lines.en: label karinspring4:
scene sky
Unable to sit around and wait any longer, I decide to head over to the dojo in hopes of seeing Osako and curing her chronic hopelessness with something other than my penis.
I mean, I would attempt to cure it with my penis if she wanted me to. But I highly doubt my penis has anything to do with the reason her relationship is currently in shambles to begin with.
So yeah, maybe I’ll try that “talking” thing I have to do with some of the other girls sometimes. And maybe this time, Osako won’t blindside me by revealing she knows about any past traumas.
Either way, I’m on my way to the dojo to renew some confidence and hopefully discover some new information that won’t make me feel terrible or anxious anymore.
scene karinatthedojo1
Never mind. I feel terrible again.
: Hello.
: Karin! Face forward! Looking away from your opponent in the middle of a fight is no different from just asking for defeat.
scene karinatthedojo2
: Oh, sorry! I just...know him. And I...wasn’t really expecting to see him here.
: I know him too, but you don’t see me breaking focus and giving my opponent the window of opportunity they’ve been waiting for.
scene karinatthedojo3
: So he...comes here often then?
: And now you’re looking away! You need to be aware of your surroundings at all times, Karin!
scene karinatthedojo4
: B-b-b-b-but you just told me I shouldn’t look at my surroundings!
: What I meant is that you shouldn’t focus on them. Always know what’s happening around you, but keep your eye on the prize. And the prize isn’t on the ground!
: Oh, uhh...right! Sorry! Again!
: Should I come back a different time? If Karin’s here, I probably shouldn’t-
scene karinatthedojo5
: Actually, no. For once in my life, I’m actually glad you’re here. Get on the mat and take my place as Karin’s sparring partner.
: What happened to your hair?
: A stylist. You should see one next. Does that really matter right now?
: Uh...I...don’t know if it’s a...good idea for Sensei to...
scene karinatthedojo6
: It’s fine. He might look useless...and he might normally be useless...but the reason you’re here in the first place is because you want to learn self-defense, right?
: Statistically speaking, you’re less likely to be robbed or attacked by someone if you’re bigger than them. So having an opponent his size will be a lot closer to how it would be in real life.
scene karinatthedojo7
: You don’t say...
: Akira, come on.
: Osako-
: We can talk later, okay? This is a trial course, and I’m not going to be able to let her try anything if she’s going to be looking at you the whole time.
scene black
: Plus, I’ve got another class coming in one hour and other students to help. So for the first time in your life, could you actually give me a hand here?
: I just don’t think Karin wants to-
: It’s fine...
scene karinatthedojo8
: Like Osaka-sensei says, this is closer to how it would be in real life...
Somehow, I find myself face to face with Karin in a way...significantly different from how I imagined our next meeting would be.
I guess it’s fitting that she’s ready to fight me, though. At least that much tracks.
But it’s not like I’m actually going to fight back. I’ll just let her wail on me for a few minutes and deal with whatever sort of disciplinary action Osako has in store later.
: Okay. Let’s do this, I guess.
: Do what? This is my first lesson and I haven’t learned any...offensive techniques yet.
: To be fair, neither have I and I’ve been coming here for years.
: To be fair, you haven’t paid any attention in years!
: That is also true.
: Aren’t you going to put your arms up to defend yourself? Or do you think you can just walk all over me again without any consequences?
: Come at me and find out.
scene karinatthedojo9
: Why?...Is this some kind of trick? What do you have up your sleeve?
: Nothing. I just know you don’t want to do this and, respectfully, neither do I.
: Respectfully, Akira, I wish you’d employ literally any of what I’ve taught you the past few years and show Karin that this isn’t some freestyle dojo without rules or regulations.
: Don’t listen to her. I’ve fought greater battles in this building than she ever will.
: ...What?
: Just hit me. You’re here because of me, aren’t you? So you should have no problem attacking.
scene karinatthedojo10
: Why...do you even come here in the first place? You’ve always been so against...physical activity and stuff.
: For Ayane, mostly. I’m not interested in fighting.
: Well...maybe you should be. Because not everyone’s like me. And one day, someone’s going to fight back. Then that...stupid facade of yours is going to crumble to the ground.
: You say that like I make a habit of luring girls into the dark.
: And for all I know, you do. So...put your arms up or...things are going to get really messy.
: No thanks. I’ll just keep them down and let you use me as a punching bag for now. I deserve it.
: Who said anything about punching?
: What?
scene karinatthedojo11
scene black
The world goes dark...but I see no light at the end of the tunnel.
It’s just an endless tube of blackness and a life of never-ending pain.
How fitting that I’d be destroyed by purity incarnate. And even more so that the tool I’ve used to paint the world red has been ripped from its holster and dropped into the trash.
: That’s not a sanctioned move in competitions, but...you know, in terms of self-defense, I’ve got to admit there’s not much out there more effective than that.
: Thanks. My mom taught me to do that if anyone ever tries to grab me.
O world-
Why did I have to be born with testicles?
scene karinatthedojo12
I manage to pull myself off of the mat several minutes later and find that Karin, for some reason, hasn’t run away from this place yet.

But instead of blaming this on stupidity, I’ll just go ahead and assume she’s yet to make it to the part of her training that advises fleeing from trouble is just as valid as fighting back against it.
So valid, in fact, that I’ve made it my life’s duty to do just that. I just happen to also be an expert at neglecting my duty, so I typically wander off to start trouble elsewhere.
In fact, that’s probably what I’m doing right now as I crawl several feet across the mat and take a seat beside her.
There are a few other girls in the dojo — ones I haven’t seen before — so I guess it’s safe to assume I’ve stumbled into a full-on beginner’s course since Karin is here too.
But while Osako spends her time actually instructing people, I’m left to trample on one more flower that grew in the wrong place.
: I’m glad to see your legs are still a force to be reckoned with despite the lack of a soccer club now.
: I’m not sorry.
: I’m not saying you should be. I deserved that.
: Okay, I’m a little bit sorry.
scene karinatthedojo13
: But you kind of deserved it for both...what you did before and...how you surprised me here today.
: It’s not like I knew you were going to be here. I just wanted to talk to Osako about something.
: Well...this is the only dojo my parents can afford, so...I’ll need to know what days you plan on coming so I can make sure I come at different times.
scene karinatthedojo14
: You’re serious about this whole self-defense thing then, huh?
: I want to be able to do something if that ever happens again. Just lying there and...letting it happen made me feel terrible about myself.
: I see.
: I’ll stop coming here altogether then.
scene karinatthedojo15
: What? But you’ve-
scene karinatthedojo16
: You’ve been...coming here for years, right? And this is only my first lesson.
: Yeah. But you need it more than I do, and I really just come to talk anyway. Besides, Ayane would make a way better sparring partner than me.
: That’s true. But I don’t know if my special move would work on her the way it worked on you just now.
: Probably not, but she’s still got plenty of weaknesses. Whether or not she can be taken down by them remains to be seen, though. She’s...resilient, if nothing else.
scene karinatthedojo17
: Yeah...
: I hope I can be like that one day.
: Nothing...bad has ever really happened to me before. That thing with you was the first time I’ve ever felt so...scared.
: But it made me think of, like...just how little I’ve experienced so far. And how terrifying and...bad this place can be sometimes.
: And I’ve still got a job to do. Even if Kirin doesn’t like me, she’s my little sister. And if I can’t even protect myself, how am I ever supposed to protect her?
: I don’t know. I hope I can get the hang of karate. I’m just not really sure if I’m cut out for it if I’m going to...get distracted as easily as I did before.
: You’ve been doing this for, like...one hour. Nobody’s perfect immediately.
: I usually am, though.
scene karinatthedojo18
: And I...I’m not trying to brag! It’s just...soccer and...softball and...swimming...they’ve all been easy.
: My parents say I’m just naturally gifted and stuff, but...what if that gift doesn’t extend to this? Then what?
: Again, it’s been like one hour.
scene karinatthedojo19
: Hah...yeah.
: I’m getting into my head way too often lately. And it’s definitely not helping now that you’re here.
: I’m sorry, Karin. If I knew you were going to be here-
: Just...save it, Sensei. We already talked about this. I just want to forget it ever happened and move on with my life.
: Well...
: I can’t believe I’m saying this...but have you considered that talking about it might actually help? Not...with me, of course. Because that happened and clearly didn’t help?
scene karinatthedojo20
: I have. But I have a few friends who would be really sad if you were suddenly in jail, and I don’t want to do that to them.
: I don’t mean talking to the police either. I mean talking to your sister.
scene karinatthedojo21
: Kirin? No way. I don’t want to drag her into this.
if karinlied == False:
: Besides...aren’t you two, like...already...involved in some way?
: Yeah, but I figure that would be a reason for you to talk to her about it since you’d want to...protect her from me or whatever.
: I think this is actually one area where...Kirin knows more than I do. So protecting her, if anything, would be more like...stepping on her toes.
: I liked you too, Sensei. Before all of this, obviously. So it’s not like I can tell her to just stop that.
: If anything, she might even get mad at me for being that close to you when she liked you first.
else:
: She’s got...enough going on in her own life. The last thing she needs is to be bogged down by having to deal with my problems too.
: B...Besides, knowing her she’d...probably just make fun of me for not going along with it or something.
: So, annoyingly, you’re kind of the only person I can talk to about this without any immediate consequences. And that really, really sucks.
: I mean, I see where you’re coming from and all, but I wouldn’t be bringing this up if she didn’t already come to me about it.
: She...wait, what? What happened?
: She and I made plans to hang out the other day but, once I got there, she dragged me all the way to the karaoke shop and then grilled me about what I did to you.
scene karinatthedojo22
: Kirin...did that?
: My sister, Kirin? or a different Kirin? Probably a different Kirin, right? Because my sister wouldn’t-
: She sure would. And she did. And to be honest, I’ve rarely ever seen her get that serious before.
scene karinatthedojo23
: But...Kirin shouldn’t even know about that? I didn’t tell her anything.
: Something Miku said must have tipped her off. Either way, your sister knows what happened now. And sorry if that...messes with your plan of trying to hide it from her or anything.
: I just felt like she deserved to know and...I didn’t want her worrying that things were worse than they actually were. Which was still bad, but...you know what I mean.
: Wonderful. So now my sister knows her crush tried to get with me in a private room. I’m sure that won’t have any effect on her inferiority complex at all.
: I’m sorry...again.
: I’ve been really striking out a lot with you lately, haven’t I?
scene karinatthedojo24
: You sure have. I’m starting to feel like Roki Sasaki.
: I have no idea who that is.
: Just...some baseball player.
: Yeah...
: Why did you have to ruin everything, Sensei?
scene karinatthedojo25
: I really liked spending time with you. Now I’m just...tense.
: It was an accident, Karin.
: I really didn’t want to.
: God, I...
scene black
: I just...really wish I could believe that.
Karin gets up from the mat as Osako gathers the rest of the girls up and arranges them into a circle.
Wanting a refresher on some of the basics (or just wanting to learn them for the first time), I stand in the background and wait for her lecture to come to an end.
I could move closer, I’m sure. I just have the lowest chance of hurting anyone back here.
Regardless, Karin gathers her things, bows to Osako, then leaves with the rest of the crowd a few minutes later.
But she never says goodbye to me — and I can’t blame her for that.
